C1.worst_defect: The hero lede runs long under 'Point of sale for Vendure', and a helper line sits between the Live demo/Quick start buttons and the screenshot, so the eye has three text layers to read before it reaches the product image

C2.worst_defect: none found. Test cards name exact figures (25 sales, 20 offline, exactly 25 orders; 200 sends make one order) and the limits are stated plainly. The one quibble is the changelog note 'Released the same day as 0.2.0, a few hours later.', which reads like housekeeping rather than information

C3.worst_defect: The quick start is text only: none of steps 1–9 or 'Check it worked' shows the sign-in screen or the synced order in the Vendure Dashboard. Step 4's permissions are six one-chip bullets that make a tall, sparse column

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting nests three levels deep under the 'Till updates' bullet: indented 'At the counter:' / 'For the store owner:' paragraphs, a details block, then errorCode chip bullets. On phone the 'Any other code:' bullet becomes about 17 unbroken lines of prose, and the gap before the second top-level bullet is visibly larger than the others

C5.worst_defect: At-the-till's three figures use three different widths and frames: the payment screen at full column width (~836 px), the cashier sheet at ~418 px centred in a padded card-within-a-card, and the closure screen at ~546 px. The page has no consistent image rhythm. On home, the 'Keeps selling offline' / 'Every sale lands once' cards leave about 70 px of dead space above the shorter card's button, and are followed by eight unboxed feature items in a different treatment

C6.worst_defect: About 140 px of empty space above the 'Pre-release' pill before the h1. The phone hero till screenshot cuts its category chips mid-word at 'Gif'. The quick start h2 '2. Add TallyPosPlugin to your existing Vendure config' wraps to three lines around the code chip

C7.worst_defect: The OG card tagline leaves 'a normal order.' orphaned on its own line, and the till screenshot bleeds off the bottom edge, cutting the 'Add charge' button. Lighthouse is otherwise 98/100/100/100 with CLS 0, and llms.txt, the sitemap, robots, JSON-LD and the search API are all present

overall_worst.defect: The at-the-till figures render at three unrelated widths (~836 px full column, ~418 px centred in a nested padded frame, ~546 px) with different frame treatments, so the docs' one illustrated page looks assembled rather than designed
overall_worst.where: docs/at-the-till, desktop slices showing the payment, cashier sheet and closure figures
overall_worst.fix: Give every doc figure one component: full content width (or one fixed max-width such as 640 px, centred), the same 1 px border and radius, and no inner padded frame. Crop narrow phone-layout captures to a consistent aspect ratio, or pair them side by side, instead of shrinking them inside a wide card.
